items.definition:
an aircraft designed to fly without an engine
He enjoyed flying his glider silently through the air.

a large wading bird with long legs and a long S-shaped neck
A heron stood motionless by the riverbank.

A type of edible bivalve mollusc.
We ordered a plate of steamed mussels for dinner.

netball
She plays netball every Saturday.

a single sheet of glass in a window
A stone broke a pane of glass in the window.

a type of mint plant or flavor
She enjoys peppermint tea after dinner.

a farm implement for turning over soil
The farmer used a plough to prepare the field for planting.

a figure made to look like a human, set up to frighten birds away from crops
The farmer put a scarecrow in the field to protect his corn.

a type of bean grown for its edible seeds and for oil
Soybeans are a good source of protein.

a plug or cork used to close a bottle or hole
She pulled the stopper out of the bathtub.

the nut of the oak tree
A squirrel buried an acorn for winter.

a short, high-pitched sound
The microwave made a bleep when the food was ready.

a soft, creamy cheese
We served crackers and brie at the party.

a silky case spun by the larvae of many insects
The caterpillar spun a cocoon before transforming into a butterfly.

the top of a hill
They built their house on the hilltop, enjoying the panoramic views.

a person or company that brings goods or services into a country from abroad for sale
The company is a major importer of electronic goods.

a quiet, gentle song sung to send a child to sleep
She sang a soft lullaby to her child.

a native or inhabitant of North Macedonia; the South Slavic language spoken in North Macedonia
He is Macedonian and speaks the language fluently.

a migratory oceanic fish, widely used for food
We grilled fresh mackerel for dinner.

An old person or thing, especially an old song or film.
The radio station plays all the classic oldies from the 80s.

A type of dog, typically a crossbreed, noted for its strength and aggressive tendencies.
The pit bull was playing fetch in the park.

a rectangular tile, often made of wood or asphalt, used on roofs or walls
The roof needs new shingles after the storm.

a frying pan, typically made of cast iron
He cooked the eggs in a cast-iron skillet.

the projecting nose and mouth of an animal, especially a mammal
The pig rooted around with its snout in the mud.

a person who tells stories
The old man was a wonderful storyteller, captivating everyone with his tales.

a set of tools
He keeps a small toolkit in his car for emergencies.

meat from a calf
For dinner, we had roasted veal with vegetables.

magnetic tape for recording video and sound
We used to record our favorite shows on videotape.

a person who wears something
The mask protects the wearer from dust.

a large passenger aircraft
The airliner took off smoothly from the runway.

a small bubble on the skin
New shoes often cause a blister on the heel.

a dish baked and served in a deep dish
She made a delicious chicken and vegetable casserole for dinner.

a dried flower bud used as a spice; a segment of garlic
She added a pinch of ground clove to the apple pie.

a small partitioned off area of a room
He spent his workday in a small office cubicle.

gymnast
The young gymnast performed a perfect routine.

handset
She picked up the phone handset to answer the call.

keg
They ordered a keg of beer for the party.

lifeguard
The lifeguard blew his whistle to warn the swimmers.

a medical doctor specializing in children's health
We took our son to see the pediatrician for his check-up.

A hairstyle in which the hair is drawn back and tied at the back of the head, so that it hangs like a horse's tail.
She tied her hair back in a ponytail.

A person who owns or manages a ranch.
The rancher rode out to check on his cattle.

A man who is a native or inhabitant of Scotland.
The Scotsman wore a kilt to the event.

A vehicle on runners, used for traveling over snow or ice.
The children rode their sledge down the snowy hill.

an aromatic herb
Add a sprig of fresh thyme to the soup.

a liquid applied to the skin or a powder used in printers
She applied facial toner after washing her face.

a succulent plant, often used in skin products
She applied aloe vera gel to soothe her sunburn.

a small, short-legged hound
My neighbor has a friendly beagle.

a large muscle in the upper arm
He flexed his biceps to show off his strength.

a curved flat piece of wood that can be thrown so as to return to the thrower
The plan might boomerang and cause more problems.

a substance used for cleaning
She uses a gentle facial cleanser every morning.

an enclosure for livestock
The cowboys herded the cattle into the corral.

a man from the Netherlands
The Dutchman explained the local customs to the tourists.

a soft felt hat with a creased crown and a soft brim
He wore a stylish fedora to complete his outfit.

a type of wading bird
The pink flamingo stood gracefully on one leg in the shallow water.

the horny part of the foot of an ungulate mammal
The horse's hoof made a clip-clop sound on the pavement.

a person with whom one shares a house
My housemate and I often cook dinner together.

a man from Ireland
My grandfather was a proud Irishman.

a dummy used to display clothes
The store displayed new outfits on the mannequins.

a garment worn by Hindu women, consisting of a long strip of cloth draped around the body
She wore a beautiful silk sari to the wedding.

the act of signing up for something; a registration.
The sign-up for the new course is now open.

a form of Japanese wrestling in which a wrestler wins by forcing his opponent out of a ring or by making him touch the ground with any part of his body other than the soles of his feet.
Sumo wrestling is a traditional Japanese sport.

a tall, narrow, traditional row house, typically having three or more stories.
They bought a beautiful townhouse in the city center.

a small mass of soft material
He pulled a wad of cash from his pocket.

the activity or skill of making items from wood
My grandfather enjoys woodworking in his spare time.
